arrival: a colleague, your accountant or a LinkedIn ad sent you there
context_notes: Every design shows a made-up example business called "Harbour Cafe". Its people and numbers are fictitious.
**Prices shown are placeholders.** Don't judge the amounts or let them move your scores. Judge only whether pricing is clear and answers how you would pay.
find_the_answer: Does it work with the software I already use?
What does it cost to start?
How long does setup take and who does it?
Who owns my data and where is it kept?

personas.name: Dana Kowalski
personas.role: Owner of a 2-site cafe, does the books on Sunday nights
personas.personality: Curious sceptic: open to new tools but burned before, needs proof and specifics
bio: Age 41. Runs two cafes with 14 staff; their partner handles rostering.
Uses a spreadsheet and a shoebox of receipts; their accountant charges extra to tidy it up.
Reads on their phone between services and will close a page that doesn't say what it does in 5 seconds.
Will sign up only if the page answers "does it work with my point-of-sale" and "what does it cost".
